name: Mikaela Lind
source:
Yuri's childhood friend.
She has a prosthetic arm and robotic implants that she acquired after surviving an almost fatal car crash when she was a teenager. Mika started working at Nagai Robotics as one of Aaila's QA testers, but now works as an administrative assistant and delivery driver.
